ghost of yotei complete edition - playst.description: Set aside the order of the Edo period. Become a different kind of warrior in this definitive edition of the standalone Ghost of Yōtei experience. This standalone experience follows Atsu, a haunted and lone mercenary, as she sets out to hunt down those who killed her family many years prior. Her quest across Ezo takes her to unexplored lands as she seeks out a gang of six outlaws. Along the way, help her find unlikely allies, forge lasting bonds and build a path towards healing and redemption. Engage in fluid and dynamic combat, go beyond the bloodshed and piece together Atsu’s unconventional tale living at the periphery of 1660s Northern Japan, obscured by the shadows of Mount Yōtei. Included in this version: Echoes of Sekigahara: Delve into a new story expansion into Atsu’s past, explore a whole new area of Ezo, learn more of the Battle of Sekigahara and master a type of new weapon in combat. Most Wanted Game Mode: Tackle a brand-new combat survival mode, in which you fight off waves of new enemies and challenging boss encounters – while unlocking new weapons, cosmetics and even new playable characters. Ghost of Yōtei Legends: Team up with friends in this co-op multiplayer game mode and challenge monstruous, supernatural versions of the Yōtei Six. Its core game modes include: Survival, Story and Incursion.
